w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Spool: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (Maximiliano lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Buffering is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Maximiliano lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Elena of Stonebridge didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
